contents.text: Good evening, and good to have you here. I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. Yes, that is a custom agent, and it's the kind of job this is built for. Look at the Custom agents part on this page, where it says a bigger job needs an agent of its own.

arguments.question: Shall I pass your month to Louis, so he can look at your files?

choices.label: Tell me how you do it now
choices.why: Tell me in your own words, and I'll pass it on to Louis.

choices.label: Ask Louis for a quote
choices.why: Every quote is made after a short call with Louis.

choices.label: Not now
choices.why: No problem, the page is here when you need it.
